cmd:
# Check AUR for gitea
which yay 2>/dev/null && echo 'HAS_YAY' || echo 'NO_YAY'
which paru 2>/dev/null && echo 'HAS_PARU' || echo 'NO_PARU'
which pacaur 2>/dev/null && echo 'HAS_PACAUR' || echo 'NO_PACAUR'
echo '---'
# Check if there's a packaged version
pacman -Ss gitea 2>/dev/null | head -10
echo '---'
# Check if file already downloaded partially
ls -la ~/gitea 2>/dev/null || echo 'NO_FILE'
